title: CRU202389: Energy Monitoring Report for 2022, information paper published 13 July 2023, including the worked decomposition of a domestic electricity bill into unit rate, standing charge per day, PSO levy and VAT
used_for: The INDEPENDENT regulator check that D27's card is decomposed the way an Irish domestic bill actually is. The report's own worked example gives a unit rate, an annual consumption of 4,200 kWh, a standing charge of EUR 0.80 per day, the PSO levy and the VAT, and those five reconcile to the estimated annual bill it states - so the transcription can be arithmetically verified rather than trusted. Published by the regulator and not by a supplier, which is why it is the cross-check and not the rate source. Exposure `none`.
